description: Korean housing subscription special supply (특별공급) eligibility by type (주택공급에 관한 규칙 제40~47조의3): newlywed (married ≤ 7 years), newborn (child under 2), first-time buyer (never owned, 5 years of income tax; public also needs marriage or a child), multi-child (2+ minors), elderly-parent support (65+ parent for 3+ years, household head). Income is a share of the prior-year urban worker monthly income by household size (LH table, 3 or fewer people 7,533,763 KRW). Private: newlywed/newborn 100% (dual 120%) priority, 140% (160%) general, above that lottery if real estate ≤ 331M; first-time 130% / 160% / lottery; multi-child and elderly parent no income test. Public (general type): newlywed/first-time 100% (120%) / 130% (140%) / lottery 130% (200%); newborn 100% (120%) / 140% (150%) / 140% (200%); multi-child and elderly parent 120% (130%) / lottery 120% (200%); real estate ≤ 215.5M and car ≤ 45.42M. Returns each type's tier (priority, general, lottery, none) with reason, the income ratio and the best tier. The announcement prevails.
